new_en:
Options | Open game menu | On PlayStation, press Options to open the menu, then go to Settings to view or edit controls | 
Controller Mapping page | Change controller preset | Epic specifies that the Controller Mapping page includes presets such as Old School, Quick Builder, Combat Pro, Builder Pro, and Custom | 
Builder Pro / Combat Pro / Custom | Controller binding presets | This data consists of presets specified by Epic, not detailed button layouts for each preset |

notes.th: บน PlayStation ให้กด Options เพื่อเปิดเมนู แล้วเข้า Settings เพื่อดู/แก้ controls
notes.en: On PlayStation, press Options to open the menu, then go to Settings to view or edit controls

notes.th: Epic ระบุว่าหน้า Controller Mapping มี preset เช่น Old School, Quick Builder, Combat Pro, Builder Pro และ Custom
notes.en: Epic specifies that the Controller Mapping page includes presets such as Old School, Quick Builder, Combat Pro, Builder Pro, and Custom

notes.th: ข้อมูลนี้เป็น preset ที่ Epic ระบุ ไม่ใช่ผังปุ่มละเอียดของแต่ละ preset
notes.en: This data consists of presets specified by Epic, not detailed button layouts for each preset

review_method: Agent read every Thai/English note pair; literal guard retained. Source gameplay facts themselves are not revalidated against current patches.
